answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the atlas is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the nadir of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the willow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
